title: The Chapel
text: I have had a chapel made at the Beacon's foot, with one stand in it. I go down at night and say the last verse to myself, without the voice. Everyone who learns the Canticle learns the last verse. Nobody sings it. Do not worry.
note: In a chest on Highmarch's walls, in a bundle of the march's oldest deeds. Somebody had filed it under property.
